title: 双语感悟：老人
cue: Describe an elderly person you know.
a:
描述老人时当然也可以用我们在前面谈到的词汇和短语，比如 kind and patient, friendly and helpful, a good role model 等，但英文里还有不少好词和好短语是专门描述老人的时候用的。

老人身体很好，我们除了可以说 He's / She's healthy and active. 地道英文里还专门有 He's / She's hale and hearty. 这个说法，是特指老年人的身体好，“老当益壮”。如果老年人走路已经需要拐杖，地道英文则会说 He / She walks slowly with a walking stick.

白发就是 white hair，灰发是 grey hair，而“花白的头发”在地道英文里则叫 salt and pepper hair。如果已经秃顶，英文会用形容词 bald。如果有白胡子，就说 He has a white beard. 脸上有皱纹英文要说 He / She has some wrinkles on his / her face.

说老年人很乐观，除了大词 optimistic 之外，还可以用更简单的英文说 He / She always looks on the bright side of things. 老人心态年轻要说 He's / She's young at heart. 很有幽默感当然就说 has a good sense of humour 最地道。老年人下棋是 play chess，打麻将是 play mahjong，经常锻炼就是 exercise regularly，打太极叫 practise taichi，遛狗是 walk his (or her) dog，悠闲地散步、“遛弯儿”则是 take a stroll。

要说老人“睿智”，仅仅用 bright 可就不够了，应该说 wise 才对。老人的记忆力还是很好就说 He / She still has a great memory. 老人的思维依然清晰是 His / Her mind is still sharp. 老人还是非常好学要说 He's / She's still eager to learn. 老年人的人生经历丰富是 He / She has a lot of life experience. 如果要说“我总是可以从他 / 她那里获得很好的建议”，地道英文里常会说 I can always count on him (or her) for good advice.

title: 双语感悟：儿童
a:
小朋友胖乎乎的叫 chubby，比较瘦的叫 slim（如果说 thin 听起来会略带贬义），描述小朋友很可爱除了 cute 之外也可以说 adorable。

小朋友身心都很健康就说 is happy and healthy，喜欢户外活动是 likes outdoor activities，小朋友“很有活力”在地道英文里会说 He's / She's full of energy 或者 He / She's energetic，性格很外向叫 He's / She's very sociable. 跟谁都能合得来是 He / She gets on well with everybody.

喜欢和别人合作就说 He / She is a team player. 如果小朋友跟自己不熟悉的人在一起时会比较安静，则说 He / She tends to be quiet around people he / she doesn't know well.

小朋友喜欢逗人笑，除了说 He / She's funny. 之外，还可以说 He / She enjoys sharing jokes with others（喜欢跟别人分享笑话）. 或者 He / She has a good sense of humour（很有幽默感）.

小朋友在学校成绩好要说 He / She gets good grades at school. 很守规矩的叫 well-behaved，有礼貌而且尊敬别人的叫 polite and respectful，是同班同学们的榜样英文是 He's / She's a role model for his / her classmates，聪明而且又有创造力的叫 intelligent and creative，在某方面有天赋要说 has a talent for（music, painting, maths 等），说一个小朋友学习很努力，虽然也可以说 studies hard，但是在真实的英美生活里 He / She works hard. 远远更常用。

小朋友凡事总爱问个为什么，英文里说 He / She has an inquiring mind. 孩子是父母的“掌上明珠”，英文叫 He's / She's the apple of his (or her) parents' eye. 需要注意的是：这是英美生活里的惯用说法，apple 和 eye 都用单数听起来才 native。

title: 双语感悟：有领导才能的朋友
cue: Describe a friend who is a good leader.
a:
你的朋友有可能是不同类型的领导，比如：系篮球队的队长（the captain of our department basketball team），大学学生会的主席（the Students' Union President），或者工作当中的经理（manager），部门领导（the head of our department），小组领导（our team leader）等。

native speakers 描述好的领导常用的英文有：

He / She is a natural born leader. 他 / 她有天生的领导才能。
He / She is quite charismatic. 他 / 她有领导魅力，他 / 她有领导风范。
He / She is confident and has good communication skills. 他 / 她自信而且有很强的沟通能力。
He / She is good at bringing people together. 他 / 她善于把人们团结到一起。
He / She knows how to motivate people to achieve their common goal. 他 / 她知道如何让人们有动力去实现他们的共同目标。
He / She is good at building trust and respect with others. 他 / 她善于与别人建立起信任和尊重。
He / She cares about his (or her) team members. 他 / 她关心他（她）的团队成员。
He / She is honest and reliable. 他 / 她诚实而且可靠。
He / She can see the big picture. 他 / 她有全局观念。
He / She can stay calm under pressure. 他 / 她在承受压力的时候仍然可以保持冷静。
At the same time, he / she is a good listener. 同时，他 / 她善于听取别人的意见。

还要注意的是：在地道英文里，“领导才能”叫作 leadership skills, native speakers 不说 leader skills ✗

title: 花园
cue:
Describe a garden.
You should say：
what it's called
where it is
what people do there
and explain whether you like the garden or not.
a:
My favourite garden is the Classical Chinese Garden, which is located near the city center. It is a great place to learn about plants and enjoy natural beauty.

The garden is breathtaking all year round. For example, in early spring, the leaves and grass in the garden turn green, and the flowers bloom, which makes everything in the garden feel fresh and energetic. And the trees change colours in autumn, which looks gorgeous and attracts many visitors. It looks attractive even in winter when the snow on the trees and on the ground makes it look like a Chinese ink painting.

I like this garden because it's a nice place to get away from busy city life for a while and recharge my batteries. It makes me feel calm and relaxed. And the air in the garden is always fresh and clean. To me, it's an oasis in the city. I like it also because I've been visiting the garden since childhood, so it brings back fond memories, and the admission fee is quite reasonable and well worth it.
vocab: 了解……（了解植物 learn about plants）
非常美的，“美得把呼吸都带走了”
